reviews.text:
James and his Crew did the most Amazing job with our roof!!! There were a lot of other things that needed repair and replacement and Boss General Contracting took care of all of it making it a worry free seamless experience.
Everything from the roof,gutters,chimney stack,wood replacement,windows & seals,fence staining and too many other things to name. We were so very pleased with all the work!!
reviews.author: Skippy “Skip from the DFW” DFW

reviews.text:
Boss General Contracting recently replaced my roof, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. The team was professional, knowledgeable, and made the entire process smooth and stress-free. They were especially helpful with my insurance claim and took the time to explain everything clearly.
A special thank you to Sales Rep Danielle Norbut! She was incredible to work with, always kept us informed, communicated quickly, and went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of. Highly recommend Boss General Contracting!
reviews.author: Natalie Mikishko

reviews.text: Absolutely terrific company and service!!! I recently had my roof and gutters replaced and thank goodness I chose to go with Boss Roofing! It was honestly an easy choice with how helpful and insightful Danielle Norbut was in handling all my needs. She really went above and beyond throughout the whole process and kept me informed before the next steps even took place and catered to all my questions and concerns. (Which were many). Very kind and knowledgeable. The roof and gutters and the solar panels I finally decided to get, ended up being exactly what I wanted. I will be recommending Boss Roofing and Danielle Norbut to everyone I know.
reviews.author: Daniel Grave

reviews.text: James Elmo with Boss General Contracting just did my roof and I couldn’t be more satisfied with the experience. Last year my neighbor Theresa did her roof with James and she was so enthusiastic about recommending him to me. My house looks completely upgraded with a new roof, gutters and paint. Oscar the foreman was polite courteous and professional through the entire process. After every project James checked in with me before work started and after it was completed. Great craftsmanship and attention to detail from all the crew at Boss General Contracting. So happy with how everything turned out. Big recommendation for James.
reviews.author: Kristi Grubb

reviews.text:
After last year’s hail storms, I needed a full roof replacement and I couldn’t be happier with my experience. Colton and Julie were absolutely amazing to work with from start to finish. They really listened to my concerns, clearly explained the entire process, and handled communication with my insurance company, including requesting a supplement. They were always easy to reach and responded quickly whenever I had questions, which made the whole process stress-free.

The crew completed the entire roof in a single day and took great care to protect my pool and outdoor furniture. When they finished, the yard around my house was actually cleaner than when they started. The quality of the work is excellent, the new roof looks beautiful, and the upgraded shingle even helped me get a discount on my home insurance. I highly recommend them to anyone needing roofing work.
reviews.author: Chris Thom

reviews.text: I had an excellent painless experience working with Boss General Contracting. Josh walked me thru the process and made sure I understood everything and felt comfortable before committing to anything. He told me I could just sit back and wait on my new roof while he did all the work, and thats exactly what happened. The actual install was done in 6 hours which I couldn’t believe. I recommend Boss to anyone and everyone that needs a new roof or any other work done to their home.
reviews.author: courtney keller

reviews.text: I was denied by my insurance and was told by them that I did not qualify for a roof replacement. Josh was able to work off that same claim and get me approved without me having to do much of anything. He is very familiar with the way the insurance companies operate and was not going to take no for an answer. The install process was painless and was done in about 7 hours. I would recommend Josh and Boss General Contracting for any type of upgrades or repairs you need done to your home.
reviews.author: LAUREN MICHELE

reviews.text: We were referred to Boss General Contracting by our realtor, who highly recommended Robby Bastian for our roof repair after hail storm damage.  We needed a full replacement, and Robby was extremely thorough, communicative, helpful, knowledgeable and professional, from start to finish.  He handled the submission of documentation to our insurance company, and the performed all work as promised, and on time.  After his initial evaluation, we were able to choose color and style and move quickly to an installation date.  Manny and his crew were exceptional and did a truly amazing job, including cleanup.  If you need a reputable contractor, look no further—you won’t be disappointed!!!
reviews.author: Renee V

reviews.text:
Highly Recommend James Elmo for Roofing

James Elmo recently replaced the roof on my home, and I’m very happy with the work. He was professional, on time, and communicated clearly throughout the project. The quality of the work is excellent, and everything was cleaned up nicely after. I highly recommend James if you need a reliable roofing contractor!
reviews.author: Dinh Le

reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Boss. Josh and the owner Robby were so helpful throughout the entire process. At first, I was skeptical and thought it was too good to be true, since I had already been denied by my insurance. Josh assured me that this is how the insurance companies operate and expect you to just tuck your tail and run. Glad I didn’t do that because Boss got me approved without any hiccups. Thanks guys for the great experience!
reviews.author: Katie Billings

reviews.text: I was very pleased with the entire process of working with Boss General Contracting. I needed a new roof, and Robbie worked closely with my insurance company every step of the way. The process was seamless for me. The crew for the roof installation paid attention to detail and did a perfect job with the clean up after installation. The damage on the wood was repaired when new gutters were installed. Robbie frequently communicated with me, which I really appreciated! I highly recommend Boss General Contracting!!!!
reviews.author: Cathy Taylor

reviews.text: Boss General Contracting is absolutely amazing! Colton and his wife made the entire process so easy and stress-free—I literally did nothing but file the claim. Colton even went toe-to-toe with my very rude adjuster in person to make sure my estimate was fair. The crew was punctual, professional, and left my property spotless—you couldn’t even tell they had been there! My new roof is beautiful, and I feel safe with my class 3, impact resistant roof! I can’t say enough great things about Boss (and Colton!). Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Bridgette Warren-Murrell

reviews.text:
10/10 we would work with James Elmo at Boss General Contracting again!!
We have had multiple roofers come out to try and help us with getting our roof replaced with no luck. Having Allstate insurance they gave us the run around and with James a stressful situation was handled very easily and stress free. He took his time to explain the process step by step. He went above and beyond to help us fight against the insurance company and get our needs met. We had a leak coming through our roof, missing shingles,  missing chunks exposing the wood under our shingles (crazy that we were denied to begin with). His company came in took it to another level called out an appraiser to help our battle for us. While the process of approval did take a few weeks James stayed in contact, helped me not to worry and kept us updated every step of the way.
When we finally got approved, picking shingle colors and all the fine details for interior/ exterior repairs was hassle free. Besides the communication I was very thankful there was no pressure or hassle no demanding dead line. He was patient and respectful the entire time. Now that we are done he has stopped by to personally check the work of the crew (who was very kind, clean, through and quick by the way).
As a young and 1st time homeowner thank you James for all the help!!
reviews.author: Arizona Wall

reviews.text: The level of customer service that Robby from Boss General contractor is next level. I had a leak that was coming from my roof and I contacted Robby and he came out the next day and inspected my roof and within 24hrs it was fixed. He is honest, knowledgeable and professional. His work is the best! I highly recommend!!
reviews.author: Daniel Hernandez

reviews.text: I would highly recommend Boss General Contracting to anybody needing a new roof. Colton worked closely with my insurance company, got everything approved, and followed through on everything he said he would do. I was referred to Colton by a close family friend and I couldn’t be more thankful. He made the entire process easy and stress-free.
reviews.author: Norma Walsh

reviews.text: Colton was awesome to work with. He was reliable, easy to communicate with, and did great quality work. Everything stayed on track and turned out exactly how he said it would. I’d definitely recommend him to anyone looking for a solid general contractor!
reviews.author: Kathy Johnson

reviews.text: Did a great job with our exterior inspection. Danielle was especially helpful—very knowledgeable, thorough, and took the time to explain everything clearly. Communication was excellent, and the whole process was professional and stress-free. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Gabby Wise

reviews.text:
We’ve been through Texas storms and hail which damaged our roof and needed a quick replacement.
Boss Roofing/James Elmo and their crew responded immediately once we called them. They worked through all issues and handled the insurance well. Work was done in no time. Not only their work is good, but their communication was absolutely clear, helping us understand each step being done. Had a great experience with a Company we can trust and rely upon.
We highly recommend Boss General Contracting and a positive experience.
reviews.author: Mona Hedra

data.summary: The reviews for Boss General Contracting appear largely authentic, with specific details, varied writing styles, and credible project narratives. The company is very new (founded mid-2024), which explains the high volume of recent reviews and the lack of historical complaints. The perfect 5.0 rating with no critical feedback is unusual but plausible for a new, highly-focused company providing excellent service and specializing in insurance claim assistance. The BBB 'A' rating with no complaints supports a positive operational history. Minor signals of potential review coordination exist (cluster of reviews from the same period), but the content itself is convincing.

All sampled reviews are 5-star with no critical feedback
